tasks.analysis: Climate varies significantly across different regions of the world because it is affected by many factors. These include the amount of sunlight and distance from the ocean. Some places are very warm with very little rain, like deserts. Others may have a cold climate with lots of snow, like the Arctic. Yet others experience mild climates and four distinct seasons. Understanding climate can help us prepare for different weather conditions. 世界各地的气候差异巨大，这是受多种因素共同影响导致的。其中包括日照时长以及与海洋的距离。有些地区气候炎热、降水稀少，例如沙漠。还有地区气候严寒、降雪充沛，比如北极地带。另有部分地区气候温和，四季分明。了解气候知识，能够帮助我们更好地应对各类天气状况。
